title: Great App
body:

author: SidV5

title: Great App, Needs Notification Fix
body: I really enjoy using this app and rely on it every day. The overall experience is great. However, I’ve noticed that notifications don’t always work reliably — even when enabled, I sometimes miss reminders or board updates. Fixing this would make the app even better.
author: AnuragPramanik

title: Beautiful Design and Flawless Function
body: This app is all about the details. The minimal UI is a pleasure to look at, and the ripple effect makes checking off habits incredibly satisfying. The widgets are beautiful and work perfectly. I couldn't ask for a better experience.
author: Akshay Anu

title: Phenomenal!!!
body:
I've been using this recently, thanks to the widgets, I was able to easily keep a track of my study habits.

Thank You!!!
author: Diana@12

title: I LOVE THIS APP
body: I had this app on my phone but never really used it. Installed it just because of how good the app design is. But now ive started tracking my workouts using this, and honestly, what a fantastic app. The widgets are so pleasing to look at and interact with. And the ability to automate the checkins using shortcuts is a cherry on top. Never had to manually checkin when I went to gym cause of this. Keep up the work💯
author: DheerajShah

title: Perfect for Visual Progress Tracking!
body:
I really appreciate how straightforward and intuitive this habit tracking app is.

Really clean, well-designed app that does exactly what it promises. Looking forward to seeing this app grow with more features!
